board_question: Are we approving discovery, platform spend, remediation or adviser review?
evidence_to_attach: Decision sentence; budget range if internally approved; accountable owner; expiry date
claim_boundary: Do not imply procurement approval or assured acceptance

board_question: Which cloud, AI, LLM, storage, observability or data-transfer costs lack an accountable owner?
evidence_to_attach: Redacted billing rows; workload tags; product/team owner fields; anomaly notes; allocation gaps
claim_boundary: No savings, ROI or margin-improvement claim until verified by the buyer

board_question: Which GDPR/DPIA, EU AI Act, NHS DSPT, ISO/SOC2 or security questionnaire answers are blocked?
evidence_to_attach: Question list; source owner; evidence location; adviser-needed marker; answer status
claim_boundary: No legal, privacy, security, audit or compliance conclusion by AICS

board_question: Where could automation touch patient-related data or influence a clinical/admin handoff?
evidence_to_attach: Data category map; redaction rule; human-review escalation point; prohibited external claims
claim_boundary: No medical, clinical safety, AI accuracy or patient outcome claim

board_question: Should the buyer use FinOps, GRC/trust-centre, patient platform, native cloud tooling, adviser-led review or AICS diagnostic?
evidence_to_attach: Comparison matrix; fit-gap notes; decision owner for each route
claim_boundary: No superiority or replacement claim against named vendors

board_question: What can be done without credentials, production access, PHI or live patient data?
evidence_to_attach: No-credentials intake; redacted CSVs; screenshots; owner interview notes; missing-evidence log
claim_boundary: No promise that review alone delivers compliance, approval, revenue or implementation success
